summary: Verstappen hunts sprint redemption against Russell's Mercedes after Red Bull's latest software gremlins hand pole position despite underlying pace concerns. Ferrari's Leclerc lurks within striking distance of the front row battle, threatening to exploit any Mercedes-Red Bull miscue in Singapore's suffocating heat on a track that punishes setup mistakes. A dominant weekend could prove decisive in the championship fight, with this final sprint event offering crucial points before the season's knockout phase.
